scheme_name: Gadiya Lohar Maharana Pratap Bhawan Nirman Yojana
other_conditions: Must belong to the Gadiya Lohar community
Must own a plot for house construction
Must not own any other house within the district or anywhere in Rajasthan
benefits_summary: One‑time financial assistance of ₹1,20,000 provided in three installments for construction of a permanent house.
documents_required: Copies of mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
